column4: If there is one thing I would leave you with, it is this: Keep growing. Keep seeking. Keep walking in faith. The truths outlined in this book are not meant to be read once and set aside; they are meant to be lived out daily. The journey of following Christ is one of continual learning, refining, and transformation. We move from faith to faith, from glory to glory, ever pressing on to know Him more.

The truths outlined in this book are not meant to be read once and set aside, but to be lived daily. The journey of following Christ is a walk of continual learning, refining, and transformation. We keep moving forward to know the Lord more and more, progressing from faith to faith and from glory to glory.

column4: You may have questions that remain unanswered. You may feel like you’ve only scratched the surface of these deep and eternal truths. That is a good place to be. Let those questions drive you deeper into the Word of God, into prayer, and into fellowship with other believers. The Holy Spirit is your guide, your teacher, and your comforter-He will lead you into all truth as you seek Him.
